set.body:
Acceptance (all required):
- One mesh topology/domain authority supports alternate realizations and field attachment; no duplicate ScalaFIM topology remains.
- Exact vertex/face order and explicit strict/raw admission policy are preserved; no silent repair or cell renumbering.
- Surface, atlas and spatial fixtures pass on JVM/JS, with efficient renderer buffer access and no new full-mesh copies.

Close after its child implementation tasks and their evidence satisfy these criteria. Shared requirements: eco-unification; architecture: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md.
set.title: U3 milestone: Make surface geometry native to mesh4s
